subject: Materials from Robert Hijmans' spatial analysis talk

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Materials from Robert Hijmans' spatial analysis talk
parts:
Hi all,

I've posted Robert Hijman's slides from his presentation on spatial analysis with R on the website: http://www.noamross.net/blog/2013/5/23/robert-hijmans-on-spatial-data-analysis.html .  I've also included some links to tutorials written by Robert, including:

 - Introduction to spatial data handling in R
 - Introduction to the raster package
 - Writing functions for large raster files
 - Species Distribution modeling with R
 - Boosted Regression Trees for ecological modeling

Cheers,

Noam
